reviewer: Codex visual inspection and gameplay evidence review
findings: Incoming missile trails contrast with the sky; owned defensive blast rings and cursor centers are distinguishable.
Six city silhouettes, three batteries and finite ammo counts remain visible below the battle area; score/wave status stays above it.
Independent 2P cursors and shot ownership are distinguishable by color and player number.

Native 1P/2P browser policies complete all four waves. Behavior evidence includes exact ammo consumption, direct/chain scoring, expanding/contracting blast collision, city loss, split missiles, recovery and reset.
limits: The successful default policy intercepts splitting missiles before their split; split/rebuild behavior is evidenced by the separate no-defense loss scenario.
The four-wave seed is deliberately approachable; perfect automated survival of six cities does not establish human difficulty.
Aiming uses only directional arcade input, without mouse/touch input or hidden aim assistance.
No human balance study, physical CRT overscan/calibration or badge/controller hardware validation.
